title: Галочка хуков / Persist hook execution state and checkmark badges across restarts
commitMessage: feat(hooks): persist hook states and checkmark badges across restarts
author: developer (fullstack-lead)
summary: Fixed hook checkmark badges disappearing on app restart: (1) Added hook_states column to tasks table in SQLite and field to Task struct in agent.rs; (2) Implemented record_task_hook_result in commands/tasks.rs across on_enter and on_leave execution points; (3) Added double hydration in boardStore.ts via localStorage (cvh_task_hook_states) for zero-flicker reload; (4) Resolved KanbanCard hook badge resolution to support store, task, and parent hooks with columnId matching; (5) Preserved CVH-021 Todo progress bar and added hookStates check to areCardPropsEqual; (6) Added mergeability sensor to gatekeeper_sensor.bat/sh and evolved modular rules in sensors.md, role-developer.md, and review-checklist.md.

rootCauses.cause: Gate 6 (Clean Merge) & Gate 4 (Zero Regression) Violation: Feature branch branched from stale commit 7b038b7
rootCauses.detail: Worktree feature branch feat/CVH-022 fell behind main by 7 commits. The initial implementation modified an outdated KanbanCard.tsx, obliterating CVH-021's Todo checklist progress strip and creating merge conflicts across 5 files upon PR merge.
rootCauses.resolution: Merged origin/main into feat/CVH-022, resolved all conflicts cleanly, preserved both hookStates and CVH-021 Todo checklist strip in KanbanCard.tsx, verified clean fast-forward merge (fa09d41, 37eae88), and authoritatively hardened gatekeeper_sensor with git merge-tree --write-tree main HEAD.
